description: 半月弯刀: front-left/front/front-right fan, same damage for every valid target

stages.action: Enable wide-hit sword mode when learned.

stages.note: Client sends attacker position; fan targets are resolved server-side.

stages.action: HitHit checks WideHit MP before resolving target; if MP is present, DamageSpell(GetSWSpell(PWideHitSkill)+DefSpell) and HealthSpellChanged run, otherwise hitmode downgrades to RM_HIT.
SwordWideAttack uses direction offsets 7, 1, 2 relative to facing direction.

stages.rule: Every valid fan DirectAttack target uses the same base damage; Delphi does not apply secondary-target falloff. The normal main-target _Attack path still runs separately.

messages.condition: adjacent main target exists and the normal _Attack hit check passes
messages.note: Main-target struck is queued by the normal _Attack path.
DirectAttack queues visible struck after 500ms; non-human targets also receive immediate internal RM_STRUCK for AI reaction.

stages.rule: Train sword skill on successful hit path.

stages.note: HitMotion runs after _Attack returns; visible SM_STRUCK messages were already queued with their delays.
